description: This file defines the 'Returns' model class in the opencart e-commerce platform, responsible for managing product return records, including adding, retrieving, and handling return histories within the customer account context.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Model class handling product return data operations such as creating returns, fetching return details, histories, and counts related to customer returns.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Creates a new return record in the database with provided return data and returns the inserted record's ID.

methods.name: getReturn
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific return record by its ID, including related reason, action, and status names.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Fetches a list of return records for the current customer, supporting pagination through start and limit parameters.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Returns the total count of return records for the current customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the history entries for a specific return, supporting pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history entries associated with a specific return.
